'''Third Eye''' is a [[magical effect]] type of [[special]] card.  It first appeared in [[The King in Yellow]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': Magical effect

'''Bonus''':
*+1 Maximum [[Sanity]]
*-2 Maximum [[Stamina]]
*+2 to [[Horror check]]s

You may not be [[Curse]]d.  (If you are already Cursed, this card does not change that.)

Discard this card if your [[Open the Third Eye]] is refreshed or leaves your possession.

[[Category:Specials]]
